items.html: And behold, you know the matter of the three vessels and the matter of the lights from MaH and from BaN. And behold, ZON are each of complete ten Sefirot; and when they are sawed, the inner body of the name MaH enters them, and they return face to face. And it follows that only two aspects, namely MaH and BaN, are the mochin. Understand this greatly.
